ध्मा {c1c} P. (धमति, ध्मात; caus.
ध्मापयति)
1 To blow, breathe out, exhale.
--2 To blow (as a wind-instrument),
produce sound by blowing; शंखं
दधमौ प्रतापवान्

; 17. 7.
--3 To blow a fire,
excite fire by blowing, excite sparks;
को धमेच्छांतं च पावकं Mb.
--4 To
manufacture by blowing.
--5 To cast,
blow, or throw away.

ध्मात p. p. [ध्मा-क्त]
1 Blown(as a
wind-instrument).
--2 Blown up or
into, inflamed, blown, fanned,
excited.
--3 Inflated, puffed, puffed up.

ध्मापनं Inflating, swelling by
blowing into.

ध्मापित a. Reduced to ashes, burnt
to cinder.

ध्मां(ध्वां)क्ष् {c1c} P. (ध्मांक्षति)
1 To
crow, or caw.
--2 To desire.
